new_constructors.meaning: An operative reasonable-inquiry condition concerning the enclosed matter where the current source does not identify whom the designated knowledge holders must inquire of. This constructor asserts the inquiry duty but supplies no inquiry-target participant, and becomes a current-source fact only when grounded by a supported rendered root.
new_constructors.name: reasonable_inquiry_with_unspecified_target

value.rationale: The two local failures come from encoding an unsupported inquiry target, not from the unchanged reader choices. The repair preserves the operative inquiry duty while representing that its target is unstated. The native consumer treats either inquiry condition as constructive knowledge, without equating their fuller source semantics or claiming C/U success.
